title: Serve recipes over HTTP

scenes.heading: Turn a request into a recipe
voice: An engineer chooses a GPU target in your platform portal.
They need a recipe and deployment files to hand off.

scenes.heading: Resolve the target over HTTP
voice: The portal calls the AICR API server with EKS, H100, Ubuntu, and training.
The recipe endpoint returns resolved component versions and settings.

scenes.heading: Render deployment files
scenes.sub: Send the resolved recipe as the body
voice: The portal sends that resolved recipe to the bundle endpoint.
The server renders the deployment artifacts and returns a zip file the portal can offer for download.

scenes.heading: Put the download to work
voice: The engineer can inspect the recipe and download the corresponding bundle.
Their deployment system can apply those files when the team is ready to roll out the stack.

payoff: A selected EKS H100 target becomes a resolved recipe and deployment zip through the API.
